Job.title: Job
Job.question: Can faith remain honest when suffering refuses a simple explanation?

chapters.title: A Blameless Life
chapters.game: Tend Job’s household and practice generous justice.

chapters.title: The Accuser
chapters.game: Observe the heavenly challenge without controlling it.

chapters.title: Loss upon Loss
chapters.game: Receive each messenger and sit with the silence.

chapters.title: Job Speaks
chapters.game: Build an honest lament from grief and protest.

chapters.title: Elihu
chapters.game: Listen, test claims, and resist easy scoring.

chapters.title: Job Responds
chapters.game: Release the demand to master every answer.

chapters.title: Restoration
chapters.game: Rebuild community without treating new gifts as replacements.
